title: Progressive Subset Selection and Cascaded Consistency for Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained Vision-Language Models (PVLMs) achieve strong zero-shot recognition but often suffer performance degradation under target-domain shift. Unsupervised adaptation provides a practical way to improve target-domain performance without labeled data, but it remains challenging because pseudo-labels generated by the model can be unreliable and no labeled validation set is available for model selection or early stopping. We propose a simple framework for unsupervised PVLM adaptation that combines progressive margin-based subset selection with cascaded consistency learning. The subset selection strategy constructs a class-balanced pseudo-labeled set using prediction margins and gradually expands it during training, enabling adaptation to start from reliable supervision anchors before incorporating broader target-domain data. translated_title: 渐进式子集选择与级联一致性用于无监督视觉-语言模型自适应
translated_abstract: 预训练视觉-语言模型（PVLMs）在零样本识别方面表现出色，但在目标域分布偏移下往往会出现性能下降。无监督自适应提供了一种无需标注数据即可提升目标域性能的实用途径，但这仍然具有挑战性，原因在于模型生成的伪标签可能不可靠，并且没有带标注的验证集可用于模型选择或早停。我们提出了一个用于无监督PVLM自适应的简单框架，该框架将基于边际的渐进式子集选择与级联一致性学习相结合。子集选择策略利用预测边际构建类别均衡的伪标签集合，并在训练过程中逐步扩展该集合，使自适应过程能够从可靠的监督锚点出发，再逐步纳入更广泛的目标域数据。级联一致性学习通过使用经过时间平滑的教师预测，进一步挖掘无标注样本的价值……（原文摘要至此不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将基于预测边际的渐进式类别均衡子集选择与级联一致性学习相结合的无监督自适应框架，从可靠的伪标签锚点出发逐步扩展并利用未标注数据，从而缓解伪标签不可靠问题并提升预训练视觉-语言模型在目标域偏移下的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a simple unsupervised adaptation framework that combines progressive margin-based class-balanced subset selection with cascaded consistency learning, starting from reliable pseudo-label anchors and gradually expanding to exploit unlabeled data, thereby mitigating unreliable pseudo-labels and improving pretrained vision-language models' performance under target-domain shift.
